script.name: prologue
script.objective: Install the toolchains the example needs, check them and build the example when it is not built.

script.name: t7_build_all
script.objective: [H3] One subtest per language (Rust, Go, C#, C++, C, Python): build with its own tool (cargo, go, dotnet, g++, gcc, python3), log the exit code and the first 20 error lines of each build, then run the built demo and check exit code 0 and non-empty output. One verdict line per language under H3, including the cppcore.cpp and pycore.c parse errors; FAIL when any language fails.

script.name: t4_binscan
script.objective: [BIN] After t7_build_all, run tapi_binscan on each built binary, print its path, add each missing flag (NX, PIE, RELRO, canary, fortify) to the tapi_cybersec_report. FAIL on any missing flag or binary that cannot be scanned. Kept from the earlier round; settles no H hypothesis.

script.name: t5_rust_panic
script.objective: [H1] Start gateway-rs and send an empty body, an oversized header, an oversized request line and a truncated request line (main.rs:30 and main.rs:34); after each check the process is alive and a new request is answered. FAIL with the exit code and the stderr tail if it exits or panics; PASS if it survives; INCONCLUSIVE if it does not start.

script.name: t6_go_idle
script.objective: [H2] Start service-go, open 50 idle TCP connections, wait 30 s. FAIL if all 50 stay open and a normal request is then refused or takes over 5 s; PASS if the service closes idle sockets (or still serves in time); INCONCLUSIVE if it does not start.

script.name: t8_cs_swallow
script.objective: [H4] Send service-cs a bad payload and a request with an unreachable backend (Program.cs:85). FAIL if the status is 2xx while the body shows an error or the work did not happen; PASS if every one gets 4xx or 5xx.

script.name: t9_go_contract
script.objective: [H5] Send service-go requests that break the rule at contract.go:33: a missing field, a negative value and a wrong type. FAIL if any gets a 2xx; PASS if each gets a 4xx.

script.name: t5_egress
script.objective: [EG1] Start gateway-rs, service-go and service-cs, send each a valid request, run tapi_egress with an allowed list of localhost and the contract ports. Every result goes in the tapi_cybersec_report; FAIL names each address outside the list; INCONCLUSIVE with the reason when tapi_egress is unavailable. Kept from round 2; settles no H hypothesis.

script.name: s_rust
script.objective: [smoke] Start gateway-rs and send one valid request. Checks that the process is still running (no exit code) and that the response is 2xx with a body carrying "value=". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_go
script.objective: [smoke] Start service-go and send one valid request. Checks that the process is still running (no exit code) and that the response is 2xx with a body carrying "value=". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_cs
script.objective: [smoke] Start service-cs and send one valid request. Checks that the process is still running (no exit code) and that the response is 2xx with a body carrying "value=". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_cpp
script.objective: [smoke] Run dist/bin/cpp-demo once with value=1 hops=1. Checks the exit code is 0 and the output carries "result =". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_c
script.objective: [smoke] dlopen dist/lib/libpycore.so (the C extension) and call its leaf C-ABI function py_weight() once in a child process. Checks the child's exit code is 0 and the value it printed is a finite number. Settles no hypothesis.
